prompt: Leo went to the police desk to (say / tell) sorry about the broken flowerpot.
explanation_ru: «Извиниться» по-английски — устойчивое выражение say sorry. Глагол tell со словом sorry не употребляется.

prompt: I didn't (say / tell) the truth about Mum's broken blue bowl for three years.
explanation_ru: «Говорить правду» — устойчивое сочетание tell the truth, а не say the truth.

prompt: Please don't (say / tell) Dad that I saw the blue bike in the garage.
explanation_ru: После глагола сразу идёт адресат Dad без предлога, поэтому нужен глагол tell.

prompt: The rescue centre email ___ that the young owl flew back into the trees.
explanation_ru: О том, что написано в письме, говорят с помощью глагола say без адресата (the email says that…). Типичные ошибки — tells без адресата, tells to us и says us.

prompt: Ronan ran into the garden and told to his grandad about the new job.
answer: Ronan ran into the garden and told his grandad about the new job.
accepted_answers: Ronan ran into the garden and told his grandad about the new job.
explanation_ru: Типичная ошибка — ставить предлог to после глагола tell. Адресат всегда следует сразу за tell без предлога (told his grandad).

prompt: Did the hotel host (say / tell) to you that the roof garden was open?
explanation_ru: Перед местоимением you стоит предлог to, поэтому возможен только глагол say (say to you).

prompt: After the film, Chloe (say / tell) her friend the ending was no surprise, though she had (say / tell) nothing earlier.
explanation_ru: В первой части есть адресат her friend без предлога, поэтому нужен told. Во второй используется устойчивое сочетание say nothing (в Past Perfect — had said nothing).

prompt: From the mountain hut porch, my brother called to (say / tell) me not to take the muddy shortcut path.
explanation_ru: Для передачи совета или предупреждения с адресатом и инфинитивом (me not to take) используется только глагол tell.

prompt: Filip messaged the chat: "Did the plumber (say / tell) when the part arrives, or did he only (say / tell) you to wait?"
explanation_ru: В первом вопросе нет адресата, поэтому нужен глагол say. Во втором после глагола стоят адресат и инфинитив (you to wait), что требует глагола tell.

prompt: Farah checked that nobody else was on the veranda before leaning across the small table. "I want to (say / tell) you a secret about tomorrow evening," she whispered. She had booked a sunset boat ride for both of us and (say / tell) me not to bring a heavy coat. Of course I (say / tell) yes straight away, though I had to hide my excitement at dinner.
explanation_ru: «Рассказать секрет» — tell someone a secret, просьба с инфинитивом строится по схеме tell + адресат + (not) to, а «согласиться» передаётся выражением say yes.

prompt: Sitting on the back bench of the school bus, Max started laughing at his own timetable. He finally (say / tell) me why he had joined the chess club in September. He (say / tell) that he had misread the sign and thought it was a cheese-tasting cooking group. "Don't (say / tell) anything to the coach, because I actually enjoy playing chess," he laughed.
explanation_ru: Перед адресатом me нужен глагол tell (told me why), перед придаточным с that без адресата — say (said that), а в конструкции с предлогом to (anything to the coach) также используется say.

prompt:
— You have to (say / tell) me why you switched your phone off on the bus.
— I accidentally liked a five-year-old holiday photo of our manager at two in the morning.
— Oh no! Has she (say / tell) anything to you about it?
— Not yet, and I am definitely not (say / tell) the rest of the office!
explanation_ru: В первом и третьем пропусках сразу после глагола стоит адресат (me; the rest of the office), поэтому нужен tell (tell / telling). Во втором используется конструкция say anything to you.

prompt: Over cake in a Vienna bakery, Marek admitted he had ___ about liking dark chocolate.
explanation_ru: «Солгать» передаётся устойчивым сочетанием tell a lie (в Past Perfect — had told a lie). Типичные ошибки — say a lie, told to us и said us.

prompt: In the Edinburgh bookshop, Mei quietly said me that she had bought the exact same yellow scarf for Hanna.
answer: In the Edinburgh bookshop, Mei quietly told me that she had bought the exact same yellow scarf for Hanna.
accepted_answers: In the Edinburgh bookshop, Mei quietly told me that she had bought the exact same yellow scarf for Hanna.
In the Edinburgh bookshop, Mei quietly told me she had bought the exact same yellow scarf for Hanna.
In the Edinburgh bookshop, Mei quietly said to me that she had bought the exact same yellow scarf for Hanna.
In the Edinburgh bookshop, Mei quietly said to me she had bought the exact same yellow scarf for Hanna.
explanation_ru: Типичная ошибка — использовать say с адресатом без предлога (said me). Правильно: told me или said to me.

prompt: A power cut cancelled the Friday comedy show in Bristol, so the theatre manager emailed ticket holders to apologise and offer new seats. Which sentence fits?
options: The email said sorry for the power cut and told ticket holders they could move their seats to next weekend.
The email told sorry for the power cut and said us to choose seats for next weekend.
The email told that the show was cancelled and said to ticket holders free new seats.
The email said to everyone sorry and told to us that the comedy show was cancelled.
explanation_ru: Первый вариант верен: устойчивое выражение say sorry и конструкция tell + адресат (ticket holders) + придаточное. В остальных вариантах встречаются ошибки told sorry, said us, told that и told to us.

prompt: While worrying on a park bench, Petra wished she had not (say / tell) on her CV that she was a spreadsheet expert, because the manager had (say / tell) her there would be a live test.
explanation_ru: В первой части нет адресата перед придаточным с that (сказать в резюме, что…), поэтому нужен глагол say (said). Во второй сразу следует адресат her, поэтому нужен tell (told).

prompt: Backstage at the music hall in York, Iris stared at her music stand with pale cheeks. Seconds before walking out, she finally (say / tell) her duet partner the truth about dropping her music pages in the corridor. "Why didn't you (say / tell) anything when we were practising?" asked Declan, quickly swapping pages three and four. She laughed nervously and replied that nobody had ever (say / tell) her to number the corners in pencil.
explanation_ru: В первом пропуске сочетаются адресат и выражение tell the truth, во втором нет адресата (say anything), а в третьем стоит конструкция tell + адресат + инфинитив (told her to number).

prompt: During the university seminar, Kenji confidently (say / tell) that the thick history textbook had changed his view of the topic. His classmates looked impressed because nobody else had even finished the first two chapters. On the campus bus home, however, he leaned over and (say / tell) me he had only memorised the chapter titles on the train. "Could the professor really not (say / tell) the difference between reading a book and reading its contents page?" I asked in disbelief.
explanation_ru: Перед придаточным с that без адресата нужен глагол say, перед адресатом me — tell, а «увидеть разницу» передаётся устойчивым выражением tell the difference.

prompt: Waiting nervously outside the dental clinic in Dublin, Hugo finally ___ that he had avoided his check-ups for two years simply because he hated mint toothpaste.
explanation_ru: Глагол tell требует прямого адресата без предлога перед придаточным с that (told his wife that…). Варианты told to his wife, said his wife и told без адресата грамматически неверны.

prompt: A short alert in the York newspaper told that fake parking stickers had appeared near the river car park.
answer: A short alert in the York newspaper said that fake parking stickers had appeared near the river car park.
accepted_answers: A short alert in the York newspaper said that fake parking stickers had appeared near the river car park.
A short alert in the York newspaper said fake parking stickers had appeared near the river car park.
explanation_ru: Типичная ошибка — употреблять tell без адресата перед придаточным с that. О тексте объявления или заметки без указания получателя говорят с помощью глагола say (said that).

prompt: Before boarding in Nice, Elena told her sister that she always picked the aisle seat because she hated looking out of the window. → Before boarding in Nice, Elena said to …
answer: Before boarding in Nice, Elena said to her sister that she always picked the aisle seat because she hated looking out of the window.
accepted_answers: Before boarding in Nice, Elena said to her sister that she always picked the aisle seat because she hated looking out of the window.
Before boarding in Nice, Elena said to her sister she always picked the aisle seat because she hated looking out of the window.
explanation_ru: При переходе от tell к say перед адресатом обязательно появляется предлог to (said to her sister); союз that можно оставить или опустить.
